article.title_es: The Salvation Army Bronx Citadel: comedor y despensa en el Bronx
article.title_en: The Salvation Army Bronx Citadel: soup kitchen and pantry in the Bronx
article.summary_es: El Salvation Army Bronx Citadel ofrece comedor de sopa los lunes, miércoles y viernes, y despensa de alimentos los martes, según el mapa Food Help NYC.
article.summary_en: The Salvation Army Bronx Citadel offers a soup kitchen on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, and a food pantry on Tuesdays, according to the Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Comedor de sopa los lunes, miércoles y viernes de 1pm a 2pm.
Despensa de alimentos los martes de 9am a 12pm.
Está en 425 E 159th St, Bronx, NY 10451.
La lista no indica qué alimentos dan ni si hay requisitos; pregunte por teléfono.
how_they_help_en: Soup kitchen on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 1pm to 2pm.
Food pantry on Tuesdays from 9am to 12pm.
Located at 425 E 159th St, Bronx, NY 10451.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements; ask by phone.
visit_tips_es: Vaya al comedor los lunes, miércoles o viernes de 1pm a 2pm.
La despensa abre solo los martes de 9am a 12pm.
Llame al (718) 665-8472 antes de ir para confirmar detalles.
visit_tips_en: Go to the soup kitchen on Mondays, Wednesdays or Fridays from 1pm to 2pm.
The pantry is open only on Tuesdays from 9am to 12pm.
Call (718) 665-8472 before going to confirm details.

faq_es.a: Un comedor de sopa (lunes, miércoles y viernes de 1pm a 2pm) y una despensa de alimentos (martes de 9am a 12pm).
La lista no lo indica. Llame al (718) 665-8472 para preguntar antes de ir.

faq_en.a: A soup kitchen (Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, 1pm-2pm) and a food pantry (Tuesdays, 9am-12pm).

faq_en.q: Where is it and how do I contact them?
Are there requirements to receive food?
faq_en.a: The listing does not say. Call (718) 665-8472 to ask before going.
